name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-graph-flow-canvas
description: Use when an upper layer (a future visual canvas, a CLI renderer, or an editor plugin) needs a serializable projection of a registered flow without knowing kernel internals: it projects FlowDefinition into CanvasFlow (typed nodes, edges with port/predicate conditions, empty caller-owned layout slots) and turns flow/node-status events into a per-node run subscription with a final snapshot consistent with FlowRunResult; skip it when you need execution semantics (use @deepseek-ai/dsh-graph-flow-engine) or a browser UI, which is explicitly out of scope.
